Application

The route to appointment as an ordningsvakt

Follow the current path from application and suitability assessment to basic training and appointment.

Official sources checked: 2026-09-19

Apply through the Swedish Police

The police region where you are registered handles the application for training and appointment. You may request a course and location, but a place is not guaranteed before an invitation.

Complete the application

Processing starts when the application fee is registered. Evidence of Swedish 1 or equivalent is required, and applicants with certain residence abroad may need additional criminal-record documents.

01ASSIGNMENT02AUTHORITY03PROPORTION04REPORT

Pass the suitability process

Record checks, physical tests and a personal interview form part of the assessment. Suitability is reviewed throughout the process and continues to be assessed during service.

Training comes before appointment

Applicants who pass the tests and suitability stage may be invited to basic training. A successful course result and continued suitability are required before appointment.
